title: Google Search Console MCP
headline: Talk to your Google Search Console data in your AI client.
summary: Read-only search performance, property discovery, sitemap metadata and URL inspection through 18 Typenode-hosted MCP tools.
description: A reusable Google Search Console MCP template for SEO and marketing managers. Official API reads, bounded pagination and named retrieval presets supply evidence for an AI client to interpret. No Google configuration writes or automated SEO recommendations.
first_use_prompts: List the Search Console properties I can access.
For my selected property, show clicks, impressions, CTR and average position for the last complete month.
Which queries brought impressions to a page I choose?
prerequisites: Typenode Workspace with setup and publication access; normal account/billing prerequisites apply.
Customer-owned Google Cloud project and custom OAuth Web application.
Enabled APIs: Google Search Console API.
Google account with access to each selected reporting property.
AI client supporting the authenticated Typenode remote MCP endpoint.
